text:
My neighbor’s "Beware of Dog" sign was less of a warning and more of a dare. The moment the postman arrived, my three-pound furball, who weighs less than a large apple, charged out with the confidence of a lion. The postman, clearly unimpressed by the lack of mass, sarcastically cried, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment has since become the catalyst for a global incident. My dog is now on a relentless mission to prove him wrong, which mostly involves barking at shadows and trying to intimidate the mail carrier with sheer, unadulterated audacity. It’s adorable, really, watching a creature that fits in a tote bag attempt to assert dominance.

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
